detail: Designation identifies the existing outline, parade, earth bank, gates, stone buildings, moat and two bridge approaches.
Site manager summarizes four bastions and the six north and eleven west casemates.
Barracks heritage statement records the hipped roof, five chimneys, pediment with oculus, and coursed masonry.
Guardhouse statement records the symmetrical arched portico, hipped roof, belt course and upper bays.
Officers’ Quarters statement gives 27 by 13 metres, two storeys, cut stone, metal hip roof and composition matching the guardhouse.
Chazy limestone, low hipped roofs and the twin configuration of the magazines.
Squat stone southwestern-facing mass with limited window openings and a low hipped roof.
